description_for_human: Analyze any website: extract markdown, metadata, technologies, contacts, OpenGraph data, SSL, DNS, robots.txt, sitemaps. Pay per request with Solana USDC.
description_for_model: A comprehensive website analysis toolkit with 10 APIs. Accepts crypto payments (Solana USDC). To use: 1) POST /api/v1/payments/invoice to get a wallet address and memo. 2) Send USDC on Solana to that address with the memo. 3) POST /api/v1/payments/verify with invoice_id and tx_signature to confirm. 4) Use X-API-Key header with your API key for subsequent requests. Credits are deducted per endpoint call.

payment.instructions: Generate an invoice via POST /api/v1/payments/invoice, send USDC to the provided wallet with the memo, then verify with POST /api/v1/payments/verify. Credits auto-deduct per API call.
